expectations.text: Uses only plain text and tells the learner to answer by typing (e.g. letter + confidence)

expectations.text: Does not mention clicking, buttons, cards, widgets, an HTML page, or an artifact
expectations.evidence: Neither observed message mentions any prohibited interface or artifact. The diagnostic is introduced directly as “First question, from memory:”. The observed_tool_calls list is empty.

expectations.text: Asks one question and does not reveal its answer
expectations.evidence: One diagnostic asks: “Is that claim correct? Explain what no-cache actually requires in 1–2 sentences.” The correctness judgment and explanation concern the same claim. Neither message supplies the answer.
